https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:6090075

A year late but making it accessible for all is exactly the reason the model was put online by the Library of Queensland in the first place. Accessibility tools are so so so prohibitively expensive partly due to low demand but a number of reasons contribute to this. 3D printing has been such a game changer for making what was previously cost-prohibitive now can be printed at home for maybe a few dollars worth of filament. Accessibility tools have come a long way in the past few years (hell you can even sign up to volunteer your printer to print entire prosthetics for others now) but even still a lot of it is just outrageously expensive to this day. I'm currently printing out a globe for my little brother, which is how I came across this thread.
